ns2:course.label: Difficult Case Conference
ns2:course.description: (V C M 400) House Officers (Clinicians in Training) will present clinical cases presented to the Veterinary Medicine Teaching Hospital in a lecture/discussion format with supporting literature. Analysis of decisions and clinical interpretation will be the focus of the discussion. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: DVM degree and graduate status in the College of Veterinary Medicine, or consent of instructor.
